text.title: One day in Petra for 75 dinars

cafe.name: Al Qantarah, Tourism Street
cafe.order: the falafel and hummus breakfast plate
cafe.when: the strip opens at 6am, in time for the 6am gate

dish.name: mansaf, lamb in jameed over rice
dish.tip: Order it a day ahead; proper mansaf takes four hours

spot.name: the Treasury, through the Siq
spot.how: 1.2km down the Siq from the Visitor Centre
spot.when: at the 6am opening, before the groups

items: One-day ticket, staying a night in Jordan — 50 JD
Packed lunch from Tourism Street — 8 JD
Cardamom tea at the Monastery tent — 1 JD
Mansaf at My Mom's Recipe — 12 JD

text.mistake: The 50 JD ticket is only for visitors who sleep a night in Jordan. Cross in and out the same day and the identical one-day ticket costs 90 JD.
